items.title: Peaceful Teens
items.creator: RareLoot
items.description:
Be a force for good in the world and help bring people from all over the world together! These cool and cute skins may help your work for a more peaceful world!

- 12 Teen skins
- By RareLoot

items.title: Gamer Legends
items.creator: RareLoot
items.description:
To become a gaming legend one must need the skills and the looks! Cool and epic skins await those who want to show their friends who the real gaming superstar is!

- 12 Gamer skins
- By RareLoot

items.title: Skyblock
items.creator: RareLoot
items.description:
Survive, manage your resources, and watch where you step! Enjoy the all time favourite survival mini-game, now available for Minecraft Bedrock!

- By Geniely

items.title: Luxury Yacht Port
items.creator: RareLoot
items.description:
Grab your friends and live like a star in your own luxury yacht port! Besides modern mansions and huge boats you can expect action-packed jetskis. Have fun! 

- Several millionaire yachts and houses
- Cool jetskis
- Contains content from the 1.17 version
- By Team Ethyria

items.title: Grid Skyblock
items.creator: Gearblocks
items.description: Explore this incredible floating grid where instead of blocks you will play on ISLANDS!

items.title: Jungle Underground Base
items.creator: Gearblocks
items.description: In a deep jungle, a mysterious structure is hidden for years. And inside, plenty of underground rooms are avaliable to be explored!

items.title: Desert Skyblock
items.creator: Gearblocks
items.description: A long time ago, an oasis fragmented into multiple islands which you can now explore. Find all it's secrets, chests, dungeons and temples!

items.title: Neko Teen Fashion
items.creator: 4KS Studios
items.description:
Find beautiful neko teen skins in this fantastic HD pack! With modern designs, stylish attire, cat ears, and trendy colors, you'll find your next favorite neko skin in this pack!

+ 12 skins
+ 1 free skin!
+ Cute and cool skins!

items.title: Emo Punk
items.creator: 4KS Studios
items.description: Emo Punk is the new mood! Pick from any one of these 12 skins that focus on the theme of dark colors!

items.title: Pink and Pretty
items.creator: 4KS Studios
items.description: Pink out! Look pink and pretty with these cute skins! Pick from 12 skins all with bright and colorful modern designs to brighten your fashion look!

items.title: Earth Survival
items.creator: 4KS Studios
items.description:
Build your house on top of Mount Everest. Float a boat through the Grand Canyon. Cross the seas to Australia, or even start your own base in Japan. Start your journey on our beautiful, blue planet with Earth Survival!

- every continent
- secret islands
- a vast world to explore

items.title: Monsters
items.creator: Dig Down Studios
items.description:
Monsters, beasts, mutants, fiends, and horrors are the names we give them. We are scared of them because we cannot understand them. Have you ever wondered if they are just as afraid of us as we are of them? We attack them at every turn and they retaliate to survive. Maybe if we stood back and listened we could learn a thing or two from them.
-By Dig Down Studios

items.title: Cyber Armor
items.creator: Dig Down Studios
items.description: The future from the perspective of the past is like an alien world. Technology becomes so advanced that it seems foreign, as if from another world. These sentient AI bots wear the strongest armor the world will ever see. Yet the colors of the armor are so inviting. If only their victims could have seen how dangerous those suits truly were.

items.title: Hacker House
items.creator: VoxelBlocks
items.description:
Ever wanted to live the perfect hacker life? Then this house is perfect for you! Drive the red sportscar and kill all of the mobs in the world with these OP weapons.

+ 40 custom animals!
+ 10 vehicles!
+ furniture!
+ Hacker weapons!
- The furniture, vehicles, animals and weapons are only usable in this world.

items.title: Colorblock Creeper
items.creator: DogHouse
items.description:
Become a Colorblock Creeper with this skin pack.

Stand out from your friends by wearing these brand new skins.

- Contains 12 different Skins
- Perfect for roleplay!
- Have fun

items.title: Mobs in Suits 2
items.creator: Tomhmagic Creations
items.description:
New mobs are in town and they have come in style. Check out the Warden adjusting it's cufflinks or the Axolotl strutting down the side walk.

- 12 mobs in suits skins
- includes a free Axolotl skin

items.title: Neon Madness
items.creator: Tomhmagic Creations
items.description:
Look cool and trendy with these bright neon skins. Show off to all of your friends and shine bright.

-10 neon skins

items.title: Pirate Teens
items.creator: Tomhmagic Creations
items.description:
Navigate the most dangerous oceans and explore what they have to offer, discovering new lands and a lot of treasure!

+ 10 perfect RPG skins
+ 2 free skins

items.title: Arkeden: The Sunshine Shores
items.creator: Antares
items.description: Welcome on the sunny shores of Arkeden, a vibrant ecological city! Discover this majestic island and its unique architecture with a variety of vehicles, such as hydrogen cars, trains, boats, helicopters and more! Move into one of those cozy villas, or build one in your favorite spot! Explore the archipels on your own or with friends in this utopian survival map by Antares.

items.title: Skywars Anime
items.creator: Glorious Studios
items.description:
Do you like anime characters and playing skywars? Then this pack is for you! Put on your best Skywars outfits and get ready to do PvP, PvE and fights.
The sky war is waiting for you!

+ 10 Skywars Anime skins

items.title: woodland Animals
items.creator: JFCrafters
items.description: Do you like Animals? Well here is a pack you will enjoy. 12 woodland Animals ready to explore the wild worlds.

items.title: Imperial Roman City
items.creator: Mine-North
items.description:
A whole imperium is waiting for you. Great for roleplay with your friends. Be a warrior, senator or the imperator of the Imperial Roman City.

+ Big terrain
+ 6 skins
+ Roleplay

Created by Mine-North and Shape Studio

items.title: Prom Teens
items.creator: Mine-North
items.description:
The school ball was an incredible experience for you and you would like to have that feeling again? With this skin pack, you have a free choice between all tuxedos or ball gowns.

+ 10 different skins
+ Prom
+ Teens
+ 1 free skin

Created by Mine-North

items.title: Galaxy Teens

items.description:
Who said you need a space suit to explore the galaxy?

*12 galaxy teens
